Complete the bar graph.

[Image: Bar graph]

codes.response: Both bars correctly drawn. Bar for fast is between 4 and 6 (inclusive). Bar for medium is taller than bar for fast but less than 7.5 (exclusive).

figure_description: An incomplete bar graph titled "Car Speed". The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Cars" with tick marks and numerical labels at 0, 5, and 10. The horizontal axis has tick marks dividing it into three category columns labeled "Slow", "Medium", and "Fast". A single light-gray shaded rectangular bar is drawn in the "Slow" column, reaching a height of approximately 9 (just below the tick mark for 10). The "Medium" and "Fast" columns are currently empty.
